svg.title: flowwrench check on the bundled synthetic exports
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal output of flowwrench check on examples/check: a missing n8n node reference, a Node-RED wire to a deleted node and a missing MQTT broker, an unpinned Activepieces piece, an orphan Huginn agent, a crontab job in a DST gap, and four schedules on four platforms that start in the same minute. Hand-drawn in the format of the check command; not a recording.
svg.text: examples/check — synthetic exports, offline · illustrative
flowwrench check . (7 workflow exports: 2 n8n, 1 Node-RED, 1 Activepieces, 1 Windmill, 1 Huginn, 1 cron; 7 files inspected)
warn ap-promote/unpinned trigger: @activepieces/piece-gmail is not pinned to an exact version (~0.9.0)
info ap-promote/connections 2 connection reference(s) to 2 connection(s): gmail-dev, slack-dev
info ap-promote/sample-data 1 step(s) still carry test sample data references
warn schedules/dst-ambiguous 02:30 Europe/Berlin happens twice on 2027-10-31 (DST overlap): may run twice line 4
warn schedules/dst-skipped 02:30 Europe/Berlin does not exist on 2027-03-28 (DST gap): the run is skipped line 4
warn schedules/herd 4 schedules start at once (Mon 00:00 UTC) across 4 files: line 2 line 2
info schedules/no-timezone 1 schedule has no timezone in the export; assumed UTC
warn huginn/orphan-agent Unused formatter: agent is not linked to any other agent
warn schedules/herd 4 schedules start at once (Mon 00:00 UTC) across 4 files: Weather digest / Weather feed
info schedules/no-timezone 2 schedules have no timezone in the export; assumed UTC
warn n8n-refs/R003 Notify sales: references 'Enrich lead', which does not run on every path to this node
info n8n2ap/manual-work Activepieces migration: 4/6 nodes convert as-is (66.67%); 1 partial; 1 unsupported: Notify sales
error n8n-refs/R001 Post summary: references missing node 'Enrich'
warn schedules/herd 4 schedules start at once (Mon 00:00 UTC) across 4 files: Order sync / Every night
info n8n2ap/manual-work Activepieces migration: 3/4 nodes convert as-is (75%); 1 unsupported: Post summary
error nodered/dangling-wire Parse reading: wire to node 'debug-old' that does not exist
error nodered/missing-config Publish: uses config node 'broker-home', which is not in this export
warn schedules/herd 4 schedules start at once (Mon 00:00 UTC) across 4 files: Sensors / Poll sensors
info schedules/no-timezone 1 schedule has no timezone in the export; assumed UTC

text.tspan: -v adds a fix hint and location to each finding; --format sarif for code scanning.
